About Majara 5 Tower, Dubai Marina
Al Majara 5 Building (also known as Majara 5) is a 10-storey residential building located in the Al Majara complex on the northern shore of Dubai Marina. Developed by Emaar Properties, the tower was completed in 2006 and offers a mix of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments. 
Prime Waterfront Location: The building is situated directly on the Dubai Marina Walk, providing residents with easy access to a 7km promenade filled with cafes, restaurants, and retail outlets. 
Elite Amenities: Residents have access to the Al Majara Health Club, a 15,000 sq. ft. resort-style facility that includes a gym with state-of-the-art equipment, a swimming pool, a hot tub, saunas, and a steam room. 
Family and Entertainment: The building features an indoor children's play area, a mini theatre (Hollywood-style), a games room, and a residents' lounge. 
Convenience: It is within a 10-minute walk of Dubai Marina Mall and is conveniently close to the DMCC Metro Station and the Dubai Tram. 
 
Proximity to Landmarks
Dubai Marina Mall: 7-minute walk
The Walk at JBR: 7-minute walk
Marina Beach: 11-minute walk
Sheikh Zayed Road: Easily accessible for commuting
